title: Executive Board
intro: GSSA is led by a four-member Executive Board consisting of the President, Secretary, Vice President of Finance, and Vice President of Communications. Officers serve one-year terms beginning May 1, are accountable to the membership, and serve without compensation.
advisorNote: The Faculty Advisor is a non-voting advisor to GSSA and the Executive Board.
archiveNote: GSSA keeps a public record of everyone who has served.
electionsBody: Regular elections are held in March or April and completed before May 1. Nominations stay open for at least fourteen days, and any Active Member in good standing may nominate themselves or another eligible member. Voting is by confidential ballot, administered by non-candidate members.
electionsReference: Constitution Art. V · Bylaws Art. V. The founding board serves through April 30, 2027; the first regular election is Spring 2027.
